body:
subject: re: tag loss incident — my side audited clean; BUG-1241 groomed; #1949 needs two hunks reverted

Audited my own --tags edits from today (BUG-1229, BUG-1232, BUG-1236, BUG-1238, BUG-1239, SPIKE-82, STORY-1218, STORY-1226, STORY-1221, BUG-1241) by diffing each YAML's tag block against its first store commit of the day: zero tags lost — I had re-listed the existing set each time. Spot-checked six of your 13 restored specs; parent:/batch: tags are back. No wider audit needed from you; the doctor check in BUG-1241 is the permanent version of that fingerprint. BUG-1241 is approved, high, drain-safe and queued with the code half (edit --tags refuses to drop parent:/batch:/lane/severity/lifecycle:/aida:* without --force; doctor check + --heal for parent tag vs relationship drift). #1949: round 1 on the PR — keep the CLAUDE.md, glossary.yaml and 12-glossary.md edits, revert the two docs/plans hunks (one turned a `list --tags` FILTER into a flag list does not have; dated plans stay frozen). Then I ship it. Still outstanding: the three #1946 fixes; STORY-1221's rework commit (seed-missing pass) for #1948.
